evidence.notes: research/2026-09-06/opportunities/findings.md; detectors/fixed_vs_floating.py re-prices any Pendle market that traded in the window, and classifies term premium against credit spread before quoting either; research/2026-10-09/pendle_history/findings.md (re-quote and the matured Sky PTs)

kill_criteria: Sky ssr above the PT implied APY
implied minus floating below 50bps, which no longer pays for the lock-up
fixed_vs_floating classifies it as a credit spread rather than a term premium, meaning the floating comparator is no longer the same underlying
legs: buy PT-sUSDS on Pendle in clips
mechanism: Pendle principal tokens redeem 1:1 at maturity. PT-sUSDS-26NOV2026 implies 4.97% against a Sky savings rate of 3.60% on the identical underlying. The buyer is paid to accept that Sky governance cannot raise the rate inside the window.
name: PT-sUSDS fixed rate against the Sky savings rate

quotes.note: retired: fills at 4.23% at $250k against a 3.80% savings rate (43bp, under the 50bp kill line); matured Sky PTs lost 2.18%/yr to the DSR

risks: Pendle contract risk stacked on USDS risk
the $3.5M pool means a $1M order eats a real part of the 137bps in impact
exit before maturity is a sale back into the same pool
the market must trade in the window to be re-priced at all: PT-sUSDS did not trade in the 2026-09-07 21:27–23:27 window, so the strategy has no fresh quote rather than a stale one
thesis: Retired 2026-10-09 on its own kill criterion. PT-sUSDS-26NOV2026 quotes 5.01% against an on-chain savings rate of 3.80%, but at the $250k that maximises dollars through its $4.8M pool it fills at 4.23%: 43bp, under the 50bp line, $1,073 a year. The two matured Sky PTs that held $1M (sDAI, March and September 2024) lost 2.18% a year to the DSR held to expiry, because governance raised the DSR inside the term.
